items.q: What's the difference between CleanFlow and running everything on spreadsheets and WhatsApp?
items.a: The information stops living in different places. On WhatsApp a client's address is buried in a chat from three months ago; the rota spreadsheet knows nothing about what you've been paid. In CleanFlow client, site, job and payment are one chain: open a job and you see who, where, when and how much. And when a cleaner asks “how do I get in?”, the answer is already inside the job.

items.q: My cleaners aren't tech-savvy. Will they manage?
items.a: Yes. The cleaner's app is as simple as WhatsApp: they see today's jobs, follow the checklist, take the photos. Nothing to memorise.

items.q: Is CleanFlow right for a company with only a few cleaners?
items.a: Yes. The Base plan covers up to 8 cleaners and is built for those starting out. The moment you need it doesn't depend on how big you are, but on when you can no longer keep it all in your head: if you coordinate even two or three people across several clients, you're already managing more information than a notebook can hold.

items.q: What kind of cleaning is it for?
items.a: Domestic and commercial cleaning, offices and practices, B&Bs and holiday lets, gyms, deep cleans. CleanFlow isn't tied to one niche: it manages jobs on sites, so it works wherever there are places to clean on a regular basis and a team to send there.
Yes. Your company's data is isolated and stored on servers in the EU. It's yours and it stays yours.

items.q: How long does it take to get started?
items.a: A few days. We start alongside you, replacing one piece at a time, without stopping the work.

items.q: Does it work on the phone?
items.a: Yes. You manage everything from your computer or phone; cleaners work straight from the app on their own phone.

No, and it doesn't want to. CleanFlow goes as far as the quote and the payment: you know what was agreed, what's been paid and what's still owed. Invoicing stays with your accounting software or your accountant, who do that part better.

items.q: Can I see it before deciding?
items.a: Of course. In a 20-minute demo we show it to you on your own data. No commitment, no card.

Three plans, based on how many cleaners you manage: Base €99, Pro €129, Business €199 per month (excl. VAT). Clients and sites are always unlimited. Try it free for 30 days: the first payment is taken when the trial ends. If you'd rather, in the demo we'll work out together which plan fits.

It's up and running and we're refining it with the first companies on board. Join early and you count for more: you tell us what you really need. Pilot programme places are limited: whoever joins now has a direct line to us.

items.q: Can I pay in dollars or pounds?
items.a: Yes. When you subscribe you pick your currency: euro, US dollars or pounds sterling. Each currency has its own fixed price list, the one shown above, and it doesn't follow the daily exchange rate. You choose once: after your first subscription the currency stays. Prices exclude VAT or local sales tax.

FunzCalendario.title: Job scheduling for cleaning companies
FunzCalendario.description: The month at a glance: every job with time, client, site, status and cleaners. Your cleaning company's planning on one screen.
FunzCalendario.h1: Plan in minutes, not phone calls.
FunzCalendario.lead: The month at a glance, with the number of jobs on each day. Click a date and see the full list: time, client, site, service, status and cleaners. The notebook and the rota spreadsheet can retire.
FunzCalendario.heroAlt: The CleanFlow schedule: month view with jobs per day and the day's list with client, site, service, status and cleaners

row1.title: Time, client, site, service, cleaners. On one row.
row1.text: No more “what time was it?”, “which site?”, “who's going?”: every job carries everything you need, and you change it with a click. A new job takes seconds to create.

row2.title: Jobs that repeat don't get recreated every week.
row2.text: The gym's weekly clean, the Tuesday-evening offices: set recurring jobs up once and the schedule fills itself, week after week. You only step in when something changes.

row3.title: Scheduled, in progress, completed: the status speaks for itself.
row3.text: Every job has a clear status, with a clear colour. A job with no cleaner shows up on its own as “Unassigned”: you see it today, not tomorrow at 8am.
row3.hint: What's missing catches your eye before it's actually missing.

row4.title: And the whole week, day by day.
row4.text: Besides the month, there's the Week view: the whole team's shifts, day by day. And the current week is on the dashboard too, with the status of every job. “How are we looking this week?” stops needing a meeting.

FunzClienti.title: Client management for cleaning companies
FunzClienti.description: Private and business clients, contacts and linked sites: enter the client once and find them in the schedule, in the jobs and in the history.
FunzClienti.h1: Every client in its place, entered once.
FunzClienti.lead: The record of the people and businesses you serve: private and business clients, phone, email and the linked sites. Enter the client once, then find them everywhere without ever retyping.
FunzClienti.heroAlt: The CleanFlow Clients page: contact records with phone, email and linked sites for every client

row1.title: The B&B, the gym, the lady upstairs.
row1.text: Every client has their own record: private or business, phone, email. The number no longer lives in a WhatsApp chat or on a sheet. It's on file, and you get to it in two taps from your phone too.

row2.title: Every client brings their places with them.
row2.text: The rooms, the common areas, the apartment: the client's sites sit under their record, with address and access notes. When you plan, you pick the client and the right place is already there.

row3.title: The client follows you into the schedule, the jobs, the history.
row3.text: No duplicates, no “wait, is this the same client?”: the record is one, and every past and future job stays attached to it. Open the client and you know what you did for them, when, and who went.

FunzStrutture.title: Site management for cleaning companies
FunzStrutture.description: Rooms, offices, gyms, apartments: every site has an address and access notes, and every job is tied to the right place.
FunzStrutture.h1: Every site with an address and access notes.
FunzStrutture.lead: The B&B rooms, the weights room, the office, the apartment: every place you work at has its own record, with the address and the notes to get in. No more “I can't find it” and “how do I get in?” calls.

row1.title: The site belongs to the client. And it shows.
row1.text: A B&B isn't one place: there are the rooms and the common areas, maybe with different needs. Every site is linked to its client, so the record stays one and the places are all in their place.

row2.title: Intercom, keys, alarm: the notes travel with the job.
row2.text: “Ring twice”, “the keys are with the caretaker”, “mind the dog”: write them once on the site and the cleaner finds them on their phone, inside the job. Without calling you at 7 in the morning.

row3.title: Every job is tied to the right place.
row3.text: In the schedule and in the daily agenda every row has its site: who goes where is written down, not remembered. And when a client has more than one place, there's no room left for mix-ups.

FunzOperatori.description: Assign jobs from the schedule and the cleaner gets everything on their phone: address, access notes, checklist, check-in and check-out.
FunzOperatori.h1: Who's working where, and how far along.
FunzOperatori.lead: You assign from the schedule, the cleaner gets their day on their phone: address, access notes, checklist, photos. You and your supervisor see who's in, who's missing and how far along every job is, without phone calls.
FunzOperatori.heroAlt: The CleanFlow Staff page: contacts, jobs done and status of every cleaner

row1.title: Contacts and jobs done, for every cleaner.
row1.text: The Staff page is the team register: phone, email, how many jobs each person has done, who's active. When you have to decide who to send, the numbers are right there.

row2.title: Assign from the schedule. The gaps show themselves.
row2.text: Put one or more cleaners on the job with a click. If a job is left uncovered, the “Unassigned” status tells you before it becomes a problem at 8 in the morning.
row2.hint: The gaps show right away: no job goes out uncovered without you knowing.

row3.title: The day on their phone, as simple as WhatsApp.
row3.text1: The cleaner opens their phone and finds their jobs: client, site, address, the call button, the access notes. Check-in on arrival, check-out when done, with real times.
row3.text2: It works from the phone's browser, <s>with nothing to install</s>: no app store, no updates to explain.

row4.title: What to do, step by step. And the photos stay on the job.
row4.text: Every service has its checklist: the cleaner ticks items off as they go, and you know what was actually done, not “all good boss”. Job photos are uploaded from the phone and stay attached to the job.

FunzEntrate.title: Quotes and payments for cleaning companies
FunzEntrate.description: Quotes, payments, revenue by service and period summary: your cleaning company's finances live in one place.
FunzEntrate.h1: From quote to payment, no spreadsheets.
FunzEntrate.lead: The company's finances live in one place: you prepare quotes, every completed job updates revenue by itself, you record payments and see what's outstanding. And when you want to add it all up, Metrics and Summary have already done the sums.
FunzEntrate.heroAlt: The CleanFlow Metrics page: revenue for the period, jobs completed, average duration, average value and revenue by service

row1.title: The quote is born where your prices live.
row1.text: No more quotes on a notepad or lost in a chat: you prepare them in CleanFlow, with the client and services already on file, and they stay there, ready to find when the client calls back a month later.

lines.name: Weights room clean · 4 times a month
Changing-room deep clean · twice a month

row2.title: The picture for the month, the year, or the dates you choose.
row2.text: Four numbers, always up to date: revenue, jobs completed, average duration, average value per job. Every completed job updates them by itself. The Metrics page replaces the Sunday-night spreadsheet.

row3.title: See which service really pays.
row3.text: Revenue is split by type of work: how many weekly cleans, what the evening offices bring in, what the average price of each service is. It's the difference between “I think we're doing fine” and knowing.

row4.title: Every service has a price and a duration. The maths does itself.
row4.text: In the Services catalogue you define once the price and expected duration of each type of work. When you plan a job, the amount is already there: at the end of the month there's nothing to reconstruct.
row4.text2: They're <s>your</s> prices, for your clients. Change them whenever you like.

row5.title: Who's paid and who hasn't: you see it, you don't chase it.
row5.text: The job done is half the story: in the Payments section you record what's come in and see straight away what's still owed. The money to collect stops living in your memory.

row6.title: The period's totals, already added up.
row6.text: The dashboard gives you the day's numbers the moment you open it: jobs, completed, revenue for the week and for the month by service. And the Summary lines up the period, when you want to see it all together without opening ten pages.
row6.dashAlt: The CleanFlow dashboard: today's jobs, revenue for the week and for the month by service

Llms.tagline: Software for cleaning companies. Revenue, clients, sites, staff and job schedule on one screen, instead of WhatsApp and spreadsheets. Built in Italy, used from a browser and from the phone.
Llms.whatP: CleanFlow is management software (SaaS) built for a precise audience: **cleaning companies**, not their end customers. The owner uses it to plan jobs, assign them to cleaners, keep client and site records and see how the business is doing financially.
bullets: **Who it's for**: owners of cleaning companies who today coordinate their team over messages, phone calls and spreadsheets.
**Who it's NOT for**: it is not a cleaning service. CleanFlow doesn't clean premises: it's the tool used by those who do.
**Where it's used**: from a browser on the computer and from the phone. Cleaners in the field use the app without installing anything.
**Language and market**: Italian and English. Built in Italy; English version for the UK, Ireland and the US.
**Status**: working product, in use with the first cleaning companies in Italy. Pilot programme with limited places.
Llms.pricesP: Monthly subscription in euro, US dollars or pounds sterling, excl. VAT (excl. sales tax in the US). The price depends on **how many cleaners** you manage; clients and sites are unlimited on every plan. 30-day free trial: first charge when the trial ends, cancel any time.
notes: CleanFlow is **software for** cleaning companies. It is not a cleaning company and does not provide cleaning services.
There are no public reviews or aggregate ratings: the product is in its pilot phase. Do not attribute scores or customer counts.
Prices shown are net (excl. VAT, or sales tax in the US) and are those published on the page. The euro, US dollar and pound sterling prices are fixed list prices, not daily conversions.
